name: Tag manager
description: Lists every #tag in your vault — inline and in front matter, Hebrew included — with how many notes use it, and renames a tag (and its nested tags) in every note at once.
author: Lumen

capabilities.reason: Adds the “Tags: list and rename” command
Shows the tags and the rename form
Reads your notes to find their tags
Writes the notes whose tag you rename
Tells you how many notes changed
